title: Computing Bogomolov multipliers and finitary Bogomolov multipliers of infinite groups
summary: We study homological Bogomolov multipliers and finitary Bogomolov multipliers of infinite groups, with emphasis on polycyclic groups. We obtain structural descriptions for torsion-free nilpotent groups of class two, semidirect products, wreath products, and infinite simple groups. The class-two case reveals a connection with rational points on linear sections of Grassmannians, explaining an arithmetic obstruction to a general algorithm.
